name: Tuya light, legacy v1 data points (1-5)
description: Older Tuya bulbs: switch 1, mode 2, brightness 3 (25-255), colour temperature 4 (0-255), colour 5 as RRGGBBHHHHSSVV. Picked for any device whose status has 1, 2, 3 and 5. Untested on real hardware: if you own one, add a pin (docs/ADDING_DEVICES.md).
